title: Complex numbers
overview: A focused revision guide to complex numbers.

sections.title: Basics
content: i² = −1. z = a + bi has real part a, imaginary part b. Conjugate z* = a − bi; z·z* = a²+b² (always real).

sections.title: Modulus-argument form
content: Take care with the quadrant when finding θ.

examples.label: Formula
examples.content: z = r(cosθ + i sinθ), r = |z| = √(a²+b²), θ = arg(z)

sections.title: Loci on the Argand diagram
bullets: |z − a| = r → circle, centre a, radius r
|z − a| = |z − b| → perpendicular bisector of a and b
arg(z − a) = θ → half-line from a at angle θ

examTips: Sketch loci questions first — most marks come from a correctly labelled diagram.
